# JoyProxy Server — Windows builds

Prebuilt Windows amd64 binaries for joyproxy-server.

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `joyproxy-gui.exe` | Graphical desktop app with built-in configuration UI |
| `joyproxy.exe` | Command-line proxy gateway (same `sps` modes as Linux) |

Download from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/joyproxy/joyproxy-server/releases/latest) or use the files in this directory.
